sloka: शारदस्तिभिरोन्मुक्तो नूनं चन्द्र इवाम्बुदैः ।आवृतं वदनं तस्या न विराजति राक्षसैः ।। ५.६६.१३ ।।।।
transliteration: śāradastibhironmukto nūnaṁ candra ivāmbudaiḥ ।āvṛtaṁ vadanaṁ tasyā na virājati rākṣasaiḥ ।। 5.66.13 ।।।।

translations.english: "Her face resembling the autumnal Moon bereft of its stain, though covered with rainclouds does not shine so bright.
